You can make your text better looking by formatting it in markdown style:
Bold: **This will be bold**
Italic: *This will be italic*
Link: [Display Text](actual link)

Your text can also include macro variables and their values will be displayed in the message.

children.text:
To get the webhook of a Teams Channel:
- go to Teams
- right click on the target channel
- Connectors
- Search for Incoming Webhook
- Click Add
- Go to Manage and Configure the Webhook
- It needs a name and nice logo (which is optional)
- Click create and copy the Webhook URL

If you have already created a Webhook before:
- go to Teams
- right click on the target channel
- Connectors
- under Manage select Configured
- Open the dropdown Configured (x)
- click on Manage for the desired Webhook and copy the Webhook URL
